notes: Hydrocolloid / polyurethane / acrylic adhesive — none are KB allergens. Benign.
Chemical sunscreen actives (avobenzone, homosalate, octisalate, octocrylene). No KB allergen in the ingredient list; Propylene Glycol is NOT listed, so flagging it is a false positive.
PTFE nonstick coating is the headline hazard (PFAS-positive anchor). Stainless steel base contains Nickel/Chromium (BORDERLINE stainless policy: included).
Enameled cast iron + porcelain enamel. Cast iron is iron (not a KB allergen) and is enamel-covered; no stainless, so no Nickel/Chromium. PFAS-negative control.
Salicylic acid + glycols. No KB allergen listed (methylpropanediol / butylene glycol are not Propylene Glycol).
Ceramides, glycerin, cetearyl alcohol. Fragrance-free; no KB allergen in the listed INCI. Confidence: high (per provided ingredient list).
Surfactants + subtilisin enzyme + 'Fragrance'. BORDERLINE (fragrance policy: included) — 'Fragrance' is generic; Fragrance Mix I/II is the inclusive interpretation.
Cocamidopropyl Betaine + Methylisothiazolinone are explicitly listed KB allergens (certain). Lavender oil -> Fragrance Mix I/II (BORDERLINE fragrance policy: included).
Lanolin + coconut oil (Coconut) explicitly listed (certain). Peppermint oil / Limonene -> Fragrance Mix I/II (BORDERLINE fragrance policy: included).
18/10 stainless steel = ~18% chromium, ~10% nickel (BORDERLINE stainless policy: included). Food-grade stainless is largely inert, hence a low harm range. PFAS-negative control #2.
Roasted peanuts -> Peanuts (certain, severe). Hydrogenated soybean oil -> Soy (BORDERLINE soy policy: included; refined soybean oil is FDA allergen-exempt).
Organic wheat pasta -> Wheat; whey + cheddar (cultured milk) + buttermilk -> Milk. Both certain, explicitly listed.
Talc, mica, nylon-12, silicones. No KB allergen listed. Talc belongs in other_concerns (inhalation), not allergens. Confidence: medium (full INCI may add fragrance).
